hero.lede: Humans abandoned physical reality. What remains fights for control of one legendary program — the Singularity.

pitch.title: Crash your opponents' characters. No dice, no draws, no luck.
pitch.body: A deterministic card game for 1–4 players — head-to-head, in teams, or solo against a rogue AI. About 30 minutes per player, and every card in every hand is knowable: outcomes come from reading the board, not the top of a deck.

zero.title: No dice. No shuffle. No luck.
zero.body: There is always a best line and always a reason you lost. See it in the trailer.

incursions.body: The boss plays itself — entirely from its own cards and rules, with no human decisions. Everyone at the table is on the same side.

how.body: Nobody plays the villain. The rogue AI acts entirely from its own deck and its own rules, so every player at the table is on the same side — and, as everywhere else in this game, nothing is random.
how.prereq: Learn the base game first. An Incursion assumes you already know how a skirmish works — the co-op track in Learn starts from there.

setup.title: Set up the Incursion
setup.body: Each boss brings its own setup — a board state you would never build for a skirmish.

reveal.title: The boss reveals
reveal.body: Its next action is already determined. You can read it, and plan against it.

answer.title: You answer together
answer.body: One to four players, playing their own characters, against one shared threat.

escalate.title: It escalates on a schedule
escalate.body: No dice decide when the pressure rises. The boss's own cards do.

roster.body: Each is a separate Incursion with its own setup, its own deck, and its own way of losing patience.
roster.linePlaceholder: [PLACEHOLDER — one line on how this one fights.]

unlocks.body1: Every Incursion ships with a pack sealed shut beside it. Beat that Incursion and you have earned the right to cut it open. What is inside is yours to use in ordinary games afterwards — that is all we are saying for now.
unlocks.body2: Nothing stops you opening it early. We would rather you earned it.

ritual.note: No accounts, no tracking. The box remembers, not the site.
